_source: Parking signs photographed on the street. Each entry records what the sign actually says, where and when it was seen, and who saw it — this is the sign itself, not a council's description of it, so it outranks the permit-area schedules for the streets it covers. Photos are kept in docs/field-signs/ so any claim here can be re-checked against the picture. Never extend a sign beyond the extent recorded in `bbox`: a sign governs its own stretch of kerb, not the whole suburb.

signs.note: Double-headed arrow, so the restriction runs both ways along the kerb from the sign. Seen alongside the new roadworks on Alfred St North. Supersedes the Area 1A permit-schedule tagging, which knew the scheme applied here but not the limit.
